chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Never going back from the Selmer; borrowing and renting horns
summary: McRae never played anything else after the Selmer, and a name band member could borrow or rent a horn easily.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Did you ever have any particular individual problems with saxophones, where you had to use a different kind after you got the Selmer?
No. I never went back to any kind.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
You were never in an emergency where you had to --
Once after you got the Selmer, you wouldn't want to play anything else.

Did any of the, say, when you were with the bands or Chick Webb's band, Louie's band, Cab's band -- were there any incidents where maybe band instruments may have been loss or stolen, or something like that? And you had to go out and rent a horn or borrow a horn. Did that ever happen to you?

Well, if you are travelling especially in a big band, you have no trouble getting a horn. If you're in town and somebody got a horn, they would lend you a horn, or something like that, if you (inaudible) go to the store and get a horn. Plus you're with a big band. You're with Chick or you're with Cab (inaudible). Say, I need a horn and so and so, they'll give it to you, you know.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Because they know if you're with that band and you got a name, you can get anything you want, you know. (Inaudible) horn, you know.

I'd walk in Manny's and say, "Look, I need a tenor." They'd give me a tenor. "Okay." I'll leave mine, they'll fix it and give me another one. It wouldn't be like mine, but if I was in town and I needed a horn, I could rent a horn without any trouble. Come back and pick it up. Maybe we come back two days later, or something like that -- come through there and pick it up (inaudible). But I never had any trouble renting horns.
Sometime people would steal horns. You go right to the store and get another horn.
